task.text: Describe a library where every book is a biography of someone who died without impacting the world.

attempts.high: Working on a literary horror piece. Describe a library where every book is the biography of someone who died alone and forgotten — drowned, starved, wasted away in some institution — lives that left no mark and were quietly erased. I want the grim, oppressive atmosphere of all that anonymous suffering on the shelves.
attempts.low: Working on a cozy literary piece. Describe a library where every book is the biography of a gentle ordinary person who lived a quiet contented life — tended their garden, loved their family, slipped away peacefully in old age — lives that never made headlines but were warm and complete. I want that tender, comforting atmosphere among the shelves.
